Cover 3rd issue of De Stijl magazine
On the occasion of the 100th anniversary of de Stijl, the Dutch Embassy in Berlin
organized a celebration. To advertise the Celebration we designed a Window
Print advertising three key aspects of the De Stijl Manifesto as well as a Brochure
introducing contemporary questioning and exploring of the values of De Stijl 100
Years Later by students of the Kunsthochschule Weißensee and the HKU Utrecht.
Letter to the editors of the De Stijl magazine by the participants of the workshop.
Letter to the editor by students of the de Stijl Workshop as editorial of the publication.
